HomePage.title: Marco Di Toro
HomePage.subtitle: Full Stack Developer | .NET & React | 3~ Years Experience
HomePage.aboutMeP1: Final-year Software Engineering student at Inatel with a solid foundation as a Telecommunications Technician. I bring over 3 years of professional experience building full-stack solutions using .NET, React/Next.js, and Python.
HomePage.aboutMeP2: I'm consistently applying patterns like DDD and Clean Architecture to deliver scalable and maintainable systems. Currently, I am exploring international career opportunities (EU and global). My goal is to leverage my technical background and upcoming graduation to relocate and contribute to a global engineering team.

experience1.description: Full-stack developer working with C#, ASP.NET Core and the ABP framework. Built REST APIs and front-end features with Blazor/Blazorise, using SQL Server for persistence. Worked in an Agile/Scrum environment with Git and weekly code reviews; used Docker, Postman and automated tests (Selenium).

experience2.description: Worked with AWS microservices and Python, implementing solutions with Lambda, SNS, SQS, S3, Cloudfront, among others. Acquired knowledge about agile methodologies (Scrum) while participating in an international team. Gained extensive hands-on experience, providing me with a solid understanding of software development in an agile professional environment.

experience3.description: Built end-to-end web applications with focus on scalable architecture and UX. Managed the full SDLC using Agile/Scrum practices. Worked with Next.js, TypeScript, Prisma, PostgreSQL and Docker; testing with Cypress (E2E) and Postman; CI/CD with GitHub Actions; domain configuration and hosting.

project1.title: Pixelforge
project1.description: Web platform developed with WebGL, Three.js, Next.js and p5.js to help engineering college professors in the demonstration of practical concepts in the classroom, like computer graphics algorithms, multimedia (FFT) and matrix transformations. The project won 1st place at the FETIN science fair and is evolving into my Capstone Project.

project2.title: PROJETE VRTL 2020: Quality control with machine learning
project2.description: Responsible for the 3rd year technical project. Developed for production line, with the ability to identify, separate and catalog products in real time, using a trained neural network.

project3.title: PROJETE 2019: Baropodometer
project3.description: 2nd year technical project. A mat was made capable of identifying the user's type of step and suggesting possible corrections for it.

project4.title: PROJETE 2018: Automatic gate with Wi-Fi
project4.description: 1st year technical project. Garage door, capable of automatically opening and closing when detecting the user's presence on their local wi-fi network.

project5.title: Groovetree
project5.description: Web platform built with Next.js and PostgreSQL (via Supabase) that allows musicians and artists to create customizable pages to share their music, links, and events. It features OAuth authentication and data management through Prisma ORM, supporting embedded players and full layout and style customization.

whatAreCookies.title: What Are Cookies?
whatAreCookies.p1: Cookies are small text files stored in your browser when you visit a website. They allow the website to remember your preferences and settings.

howWeUseCookies.title: How We Use Cookies
howWeUseCookies.p1: This website uses only essential cookies stored locally in your browser to: (1) Remember your language preference (Portuguese or English), (2) Remember your theme preference (light or dark mode). These cookies do not track your activity, do not collect personal data, and are not shared with third parties.
